lifecycles._note: COVERAGE-ONLY guarded lifecycle for data-ops's uncovered WRITE endpoints. Live-run 2026-06-24 confirmed: (1) createdataops: storage_class_name must be non-empty ('' causes 400 'storage class name should not be null'; 'default' gets 404 cluster not found - body passes validation). (2) createdataopsservice: service_workload format 'Input dataOpsServiceWorkload is not valid' for all tried formats (scheduler/web_server/worker with cpu/memory/replica/version strings/ints) - unknown valid format, backend validates before ID lookup. (3) id-bound PUTs/DELETEs: 400 'Input id must start with DOPS-/DOPS_SERVICE-' when soft-capture returns nothing (empty account) - need real IDs. (4) validate-resources-update: same id format error. All 12 remaining are heavy-prereq: need a real billable Airflow cluster to get 2xx. This lifecycle is heavy:true; when run with SCP_RUN_HEAVY=true it records 8 catalog-key 4xxes providing diagnostic data. DELETEs are destructive:true.

steps.name: capture-image-version
steps._note: discovery GET (getdataopsimageversionv1, confirmed data/api_docs.json response schema ImageVersionsResponse -> $.contents[].version) — lead from docs-research §1 (CAMPAIGN-C3-100-docs-research.md): createdataopsservice's service_workload.*.version had no documented enum/example (blank in api_docs), and the live 2026-06-24 attempt with a hardcoded '2.7.3' 400'd 'Input dataOpsServiceWorkload is not valid'. This read-only probe captures the account's REAL available Airflow version so create-data-ops-service can inject it instead of guessing. capture_soft (not hard): per engine.py `_fill`, a step whose expr resolves to nothing leaves the ctx var unset, so the downstream {dops_image_version} placeholder stays LITERAL text in the body (engine substitutes ctx.get(key, <literal-placeholder>)) — the create step's broad expect_status already tolerates the resulting 400 harmlessly, same as before this fix. **Live-unverified**: whether the real version string differs from '2.7.3' (the value already in use) is exactly what this probe is meant to discover.

steps.name: create-data-ops
steps._note: storage_class_name must be non-empty; empty string causes 400 'storage class name should not be null' (live-proven 2026-06-24). 'default' passes body validation and gets 404 (cluster not found) with a fake cluster_id. With a real cluster_id and ingress_controller_name this would proceed to create.

steps.name: create-data-ops-service
steps._note: version now injected from the new capture-image-version probe ({dops_image_version} <- GET /v1/data-ops/image-versions $.contents[0].version) instead of a hardcoded '2.7.3' — the hardcoded value already 400'd 'Input dataOpsServiceWorkload is not valid' live (2026-06-24), so this substitutes the account's REAL reported version per docs-research §1's lead. cpu/memory/replica/worker_type left at the doc-example values verbatim ('2000'/'1024'/'1' cpu-millicores-style strings, worker_type='KubernetesExecutor' guessed from knowledge/formal/services/data-analytics__data-ops.yaml's Kubernetes|Celery userguide enum) — data/api_docs.json's `dataopsservicecreaterequest` model leaves these as untyped/unbounded strings with no enum/min/max documented, so their value-domain remains UNVERIFIED residual uncertainty; if 'Input dataOpsServiceWorkload is not valid' persists even with a real version string, cpu/memory/replica/worker_type become the next suspects. **Live-unverified.**

lifecycles._note: COVERAGE-ONLY read lifecycle for data-ops's id-bound GETs (READ-ONLY, never mutates). Lists the data-ops and data-ops-services collections, soft-captures ids under the EXACT catalog path-param names (data_ops_id, cluster_id) so the final probe-reads step exercises every catalog GET whose params are satisfied: getdataops (/v1/data-ops/{data_ops_id}), getdataopssubversions (/v1/data-ops-services/data-ops/{data_ops_id}/sub-versions) and the data-ops ingress-controllers (/v1/data-ops/clusters/{cluster_id}/ingress-controllers). The two check-duplication GETs take a free-form NAME path-param (not an id), so they are called directly with a literal probe name (duplication-check accepts any name -> 200/400, still RECORDED). When a collection is empty the {var} normalizes to the catalog '*' key so each endpoint is still CALLED and a 4xx counts as covered. Every step optional + grouped + broad expect_status so an isolated failure never fails the run. cluster_id is harvested from the service detail (best-effort); when absent the ingress probe still records against the '*' key.

steps.name: check-data-ops-duplication
steps._note: id-bound read (checkduplicationcontrollerv1). Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/data-ops/{data_ops_name}/check-duplication. The catalog path-param {data_ops_name} is a free-form NAME, so we send a templated probe name (regr{ualpha} renders to a valid lowercase name AND, because it contains a {token}, the segment normalizes to the catalog '*' key — a literal segment would NOT match). Tolerant [200,400,403,404]: duplication-check accepts any name -> 200/400, returns 200. params:{} added so engine also records under catalog key (checkduplicationcontrollerv1).

Tolerant [200,400,403,404]; returns 200. params:{} added so engine also records under catalog key (checkduplicationcontroller).
